intro: Romance, magic, and chaos collide in this charming romantic-comedy visual novel.
description:
Love Spell: Written In The Stars is a romantic-comedy otome visual novel where one enchanted spellbook turns a young girl's love life upside down.

After saving the life of a mysterious old woman, Luna receives an enchanted spellbook capable of making anyone whose name she writes inside of it fall madly in love with her until the next full moon. Unfortunately, she... uh... didn't read the instructions.

Following a terrible day, a broken heart, and one too many drinks at the local bar, Luna accidentally unleashes a chain of magical mishaps that sends her life spiraling into chaos!

Meet a colorful cast of friends, uncover long-forgotten secrets, and pursue romance with four unique bachelors as your choices shape the story and determine who captures Luna's heart.

Features:
-A romantic-comedy otome visual novel full of humor, charm, and penguin puns (badum-tss!)
-4 romanceable bachelors with unique routes and endings
-Beautiful character artwork and CG illustrations
-Hours of story content across multiple routes
-A charming fantasy world packed with memorable characters, adventure, and adorable penguins

Will you find true love before the spell wears off?
